vex_evidence.summary: Brighton Fringe approved and co-branded a Brighton Station poster campaign featuring both the Fringe and Half a Camel logos. The campaign created a false sense of operational safety, even though the advertised venues were uninsurable.
quoted_text: Official poster artwork submitted and approved by Brighton Fringe.
Half a Camel and Brighton Fringe logos featured side by side.
Directing ticket sales to official Brighton Fringe system.
